`✶ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The three key v6 design decisions that made this work without a dotted-path import of the hyphenated `llm-wiki` directory: (1) `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` to load `ingest-orcina.py` by filesystem path; (2) no `__init__.py` in `markdown_qa/` so pytest's rootdir-walk adds the directory to `sys.path`, enabling bare sibling imports; (3) the regression test copies files to `tmp_path` via `shutil.copy` rather than referencing them by Python dotted path — making all three paths filesystem-only.
